Transaction settlement/checkpoint updated. Emitted when a transaction's
settlement or checkpoint state changes (typically during reconciliation).
Carries the latest `WebhookTransactionData`; `status` reflects the new state.
Retries share the same `CrowdSplit-Notification-Id`.
